title: After the Yasuda Kinen: My Kind of Courage

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I pour my heart and soul into the race, run as hard as I can… and I manage to win!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It seems my feelings have reached Zephyr. She says she now has the courage to overcome the hurdle she's been facing.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Next is the Sprinters Stakes. Just like last year, I'm up against Bakushin O and Zephyr. But things are different this year.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I've changed, and Trainer is even more wonderful. I want to give our current selves a perfect victory!
